source.author: ov
source.text: Mons erat infectus variarum caede ferarum; iamque dies medius rerum contraxerat umbras et sol ex aequo meta distabat utraque, cum iuvenis placido per devia lustra vagantes participes operum compellat Hyantius ore:
source.text_original: Mons erat infectus variarum caede ferarum; / iamque dies medius rerum contraxerat umbras / et sol ex aequo meta distabat utraque, / cum iuvenis placido per devia lustra vagantes / participes operum compellat Hyantius ore:
source.text_english: A mountain was stained with the slaughter of various wild beasts; and now the middle of the day had drawn together the shadows of things, and the sun was at the same distance from either boundary, when the Hyantian youth addressed with calm voice the companions roaming through the outlying woods as partners in the hunt:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at quibus arvorum studiumque insontis aratri, hos stimulant magnaque ratem per lustra viasque visi laude canunt manifesto in lumine Fauni silvarumque deae atque elatis cornibus Amnes.
reuse.text_original: at quibus arvorum studiumque insontis aratri, / hos stimulant magnaque ratem per lustra viasque / visi laude canunt manifesto in lumine Fauni / silvarumque deae atque elatis cornibus Amnes.
reuse.text_english: But those in whom there is a passion for the fields and for the guiltless plough, these are spurred on; and, as they are seen, they sing of the raft through the years and roads with great praise, in clear light, along with Fauni, the goddesses of the woods, and the Rivers with uplifted horns.
